title: Chief of aerospace medicine attached to NASA and the Air Force saw something

tellings.quote: I just interviewed a uh uh chief uh of aerospace medicine, you know, one of the top doctors. He was attached to NASA. He was at the the Air Force. He was a senior doctor there. Uh and he saw something.

plain: A former chief of aerospace medicine, one of the top doctors working with NASA and the Air Force, is said to have seen something unexplained. Michels says he had just interviewed the man, whom he describes as "a senior doctor there," and says only that "he saw something." He does not name the doctor or say what he saw.
